title: AutoFixture
description: Automate test data creation with AutoFixture to reduce boilerplate in unit tests.

data.text: `AutoFixture` reduces the Arrange phase of tests by automatically creating test data. It generates anonymous variables for your types so you can focus on the test logic rather than object construction.
Use `fixture.Create<T>()` to generate an instance of any type with random but valid data.

data.title: Basic AutoFixture Usage

data.text: AutoFixture can be customized to produce specific values for certain properties, which is useful for testing edge cases.

data.title: Customizing a Property
data.content: Override specific properties while letting AutoFixture fill the rest.

terms.definition: The main entry point for creating anonymous test data.
Generates an instance of type T with randomized values.
Starts a customization pipeline to override specific properties.

data.title: Tip
data.text: Combine AutoFixture with xUnit Theories using `[AutoData]` to automatically inject fixture data into your test methods.

data.title: Key Takeaways
points: AutoFixture eliminates manual test object setup
Works seamlessly with xUnit, NUnit, and MSTest
data.takeaway: AutoFixture keeps tests focused on behavior by automating test data creation.
